common.responsibility: Process, SDK, and deadline primitives shared by engineering automation.

development.responsibility: Local contributor setup that is not part of CI or release execution.

performance.responsibility: Benchmark execution, immutable evidence, budget evaluation, and reports.

quality.responsibility: Static quality, documentation, coverage, ADR, and policy gates.

release.responsibility: Release candidate orchestration, artifacts, publication, SBOM, and evidence.

testing.responsibility: Repository, integration, specification, example, and runtime verification.

tools.responsibility: Compiled engineering-only utilities invoked by domain automation.

rootEntrypoints.purpose: Run the reviewed performance evidence workflow.
rootEntrypoints.inputs: Benchmark mode, optional engine lifecycle flags, and the versioned performance contract.
rootEntrypoints.outputs: BenchmarkDotNet results, normalized evidence, and policy reports below artifacts/.
rootEntrypoints.sideEffects: Builds projects, writes artifacts, and can start and stop database containers.

rootEntrypoints.purpose: Validate that repository support and disposition evidence is publication-ready.
rootEntrypoints.inputs: Repository documentation, support contracts, and generated disposition evidence.
rootEntrypoints.outputs: A pass or fail result with actionable diagnostics.
rootEntrypoints.sideEffects: May refresh deterministic validation artifacts in the normal build output tree.

rootEntrypoints.purpose: Install the repository-managed local Git hook contract.
rootEntrypoints.inputs: The checked-out repository and its versioned .githooks directory.
rootEntrypoints.sideEffects: Changes only the local repository Git configuration.

rootEntrypoints.purpose: Report whether a release tag on the current commit would qualify.
rootEntrypoints.inputs: An optional commit selection; otherwise HEAD.
rootEntrypoints.outputs: One line per qualification precondition, and a non-zero exit when any fails.
rootEntrypoints.sideEffects: None. Allocates no runner, writes no file, and creates no tag.

rootEntrypoints.purpose: Run the deterministic repository quality contract used locally and in CI.
rootEntrypoints.inputs: The tracked repository tree, generated contracts, and the pinned .NET SDK.
rootEntrypoints.outputs: Formatting, analyzer, documentation, ADR, and policy gate results.
rootEntrypoints.sideEffects: Builds engineering tools and writes normal build intermediates and artifacts.

rootEntrypoints.purpose: Build and reconcile a complete release candidate without publishing packages.
rootEntrypoints.inputs: An immutable source revision, release metadata, and the selected execution stage.
rootEntrypoints.outputs: Packages, SBOMs, checksums, evidence manifests, and reconciliation reports.
rootEntrypoints.sideEffects: Builds projects, writes release artifacts, and can run container-backed verification.

rootEntrypoints.purpose: Compile and verify every public example contract.
rootEntrypoints.inputs: The example projects and their versioned documentation contracts.
rootEntrypoints.outputs: Build and behavior verification results for all examples.
rootEntrypoints.sideEffects: Builds example projects and writes normal build intermediates.

rootEntrypoints.purpose: Run the live database integration matrix with owned lifecycle controls.
rootEntrypoints.inputs: Engine selection, lifecycle flags, and test-owned database configuration.
rootEntrypoints.outputs: Integration test results and engine-specific diagnostics.
rootEntrypoints.sideEffects: Can start and stop database containers and writes test artifacts.

rootEntrypoints.purpose: Verify migration bundles and deployment behavior across supported engines.
rootEntrypoints.inputs: Supported engine profiles, migration fixtures, and lifecycle flags.
rootEntrypoints.outputs: Migration bundle and deployment matrix results.
rootEntrypoints.sideEffects: Builds migration assets, writes artifacts, and can manage database containers.

rootEntrypoints.purpose: Verify trimming, NativeAOT, and deployment runtime posture.
rootEntrypoints.inputs: Runtime posture fixtures, selected lifecycle mode, and the pinned SDK.
rootEntrypoints.outputs: Trim, NativeAOT, and runtime smoke evidence.
rootEntrypoints.sideEffects: Publishes test applications, writes artifacts, and can manage containers.

rootEntrypoints.purpose: Run specification and live functional tests against every supported database target.
rootEntrypoints.inputs: The versioned specification target contract and test-owned database configuration.
rootEntrypoints.outputs: Per-target TRX results and database lifecycle evidence below artifacts/spec-tests/.
rootEntrypoints.sideEffects: Builds the functional test project, starts and removes database containers, and writes test artifacts.

rootEntrypoints.purpose: Run the deterministic repository test contract that does not require live engines.
rootEntrypoints.inputs: The repository test projects, engineering tests, and pinned SDK.
rootEntrypoints.outputs: Repository unit, functional, and engineering test results.
rootEntrypoints.sideEffects: Builds test projects and writes normal test and coverage artifacts.

rootEntrypoints.purpose: Validate and render the repository ADR corpus against the MADR profile.
rootEntrypoints.inputs: The decision corpus and the versioned MADR profile.
rootEntrypoints.outputs: ADR validation diagnostics and the deterministic decision index.
rootEntrypoints.sideEffects: Builds the ADR validator and can refresh the generated ADR index.
